source_cohort: Campaign VII B1 Mayan rotation key
Campaign VII B4 LP2-56 hash/KDF key
Campaign VII C2 cuneiform/base-60 numeric keys
frozen_state: Archived source JSON outcomes were visible; this exact local grid and controls frozen before local manuscript replay. Not a preregistered independent discovery search.
grid: 12 named source key streams (2 B1, 5 B4, 5 C2) ×56 targets (55 rune-bearing LP2-00–55 excluding LP2-50, plus source WHOLE joined stream) ×2 signs ×2 Atbash choices ×2 F-interrupter clocks = 5,376 source operations. Page-local key phase zero, WHOLE phase continuous. No hidden offsets.
source_rule: For each GP29 ciphertext index apply optional Atbash then add or subtract current key modulo29. Plain clock advances at every rune; INT clock emits F literally when ciphertext is F and does not advance key. Score complete GP transliteration with pinned English quadgram score_norm. Source threshold >−5.2.

key_rules.B1: 13 literal rotations [10,2,14,7,19,6,18,12,7,8,17,0,19], forward and reversed, repeated. Historical attribution remains a source claim.
key_rules.B4: Printed LP2-56 64-byte hash converted to byte residues mod29, 128 hex nibbles, SHAKE256 of hash bytes, SHA-512 iterative digest chain, or BLAKE2b iterative digest chain; source build produces each to len(WHOLE)+8 then repeats when needed.
key_rules.C2: Five pinned numeric keys: 17,13,55,1; reverse; decimal digits 1033; decimal digits 3301; and the 12-value concatenation. Entries reduced mod29.

controls: Before local target scores, fixed three known messages: full LP2-56 reading (85 runes), complete LP1 warning reading (184), and deterministic repeated LP2-56 prefix (277). For all 12 streams×2 signs×2 Atbash×2 clocks, inverse-encipher at zero phase and decode, requiring exact complete precomputed plaintext equality. INT controls preserve F as literal null; where a non-F plaintext rune would require ciphertext F, it is replaced with known literal F during plant construction and clock remains fixed. This controls executable F rule but is not an unchanged manuscript reading. Separately count source score >−5.2 as detector power. No-INT 144/144 and INT 141/144 plants clear the bar; every one of 96 parameter branches clears it in at least two of the three known messages.
exclusions: No nonzero phase, alternate key origin, other hash sources or KDFs, arbitrary cuneiform reading, different F rule, language/scorer, or true key search. Source score bar is a heuristic, not a probability model.
